# cb:b554

> Per-belief atomic files (one JSON file per node at beliefs/<ns>/<local>.json) are preferred over both the single-file array and per-entity grouping. The cross-entity-composition concern recorded against per-entity files (cb:b112) does not apply to per-node files: every belief is addressed uniformly and composition stays via deps. Per-node files eliminate the _keys whole-array churn-suppression workaround, align with the anti-digest principle (cb:b386), and prepare the store for a database backend. Constraint: multi-node writes (e.g. supersession) lose single-file write-atomicity and become N file writes, acceptable at local/single-writer scale or via an all-or-nothing write helper. cb:b112's supersession is deferred to cb:b560 so the active graph does not claim per-file storage before the code implements it.
